name: Gridfinity Boxes (bins)
_texts: variant titles and parameter labels and help are {en, de} objects; the page shows the visitor's language (German uses du)
frame: Box centred in X/Y; z = 0 is the underside of the feet; the label (if any) sits on the +Y wall and runs along X.

source.standard: Onshape 'TemplateBox_HeightAdjust' (aee95cbe04963c37301ca12a, version 1709bdbec751f2c8b82e4d11, Part Studio 'Template'); same tree as 'TemplateBox' 009f11a5d6c90faddac6565f but with height in 7 mm units
source.label: Onshape 'Gridfinity_box_Beschriftung' (23ef78d9a8fac409ffab3feb, Part Studio 'GridFinityStorageWithLabel'): derives the template and adds label ledge, label plate and scoop

official._source: gridfinity.xyz/specification, as encoded in gridfinity-rebuilt-openscad src/core/standard.scad

foot._note: [z, offset from the 42 mm cell outline]: 0.8 @ 45 deg, 1.8 vertical, 2.15 @ 45 deg = 4.75; corner radius = 4 - offset

lip._note: inward from the box outline, above the wall top T: 0.7 @ 45 deg, 1.8 vertical, 1.9 @ 45 deg to the outer edge (4.4 high, 2.6 deep), top edge rounded r 0.6

magnet._note: 4 per cell at (+-13, +-13) from the cell centre, for 6 x 2 mm magnets

design._note: Not defined by the standard; taken from the Onshape designs.
design._bridge_z: the bottom between the feet of a multi-cell box: the feet continue vertically from 4.75 to 5.0 because the baseplate ridges between cells reach z = 5.0 (baseplate_params.json; node/plate_fit.mjs). Same 0.25 mm groove as the Onshape template.

label._note: Ledge along X on the +Y inner wall: top at T - plate_drop - plate_t, 13 deep from the inner wall, 0.95 front edge, supported at 60 deg from the wall. The plate fills the pocket between ledge front and lip, its top plate_drop below the wall top.
label._plate_drop: Changed 2026-10-24 (user decision; Onshape: 0, flush with T). A box stacked on top reaches T - 0.35 with its feet (node/stack_fit.mjs), so a flush plate carried it 0.35 mm high; at 0.5 the plate clears it by 0.15 mm.

scoop._note: Concave fill between floor and the -Y inner wall (label box only). Onshape uses r 25 at every height, which pokes above the lip of boxes lower than 5 units; here r = min(25, T - floor_top - lip_support - 0.5).

insert._note: Tool insert (variant insert, src/insert.js, spec insert_spec.md): a standard box whose floor slab is raised to the fill top, with one pocket per tool (tool outline + clearance + finger cutouts). A box stacked on top seats with its z = 0 at T + lip.height - foot.height = T - 0.35; fill and tool tops stay stack_gap below that.
insert._min_wall: fill material between a pocket and the opening under the lip (s = lip.depth), and between neighbouring pockets
insert._depth_extra: default pocket depth = tool height + depth_extra (the tool sits that much below the insert surface)
insert._tolerances: mm: max deviation of the polygonised clearance rounds and finger circles, and of the pocket outline simplification
insert._max_units: footprint limit of the automatic size (8 x 42 = 336 mm fits the 360 mm bed)

help.en: X, 42 mm per unit; the label runs along it
help.de: X, 42 mm pro Einheit; die Beschriftung läuft entlang

help.en: per side, mm; makes the label plate smaller
help.de: pro Seite, mm; macht das Beschriftungsschild kleiner

help.en: per side, mm, between tool and pocket wall
help.de: pro Seite, mm, zwischen Werkzeug und Taschenwand

help.en: mm below the highest possible insert surface; saves material in tall boxes
help.de: mm unter der höchstmöglichen Einsatzoberfläche; spart Material in hohen Boxen

rugged_case._note: Informational fit check against Gridfinity/spec/case_params.json (z_count 5..25, x/y 3..8). A box of h units fits a case of z_count >= h: the lip clears the closed lid by 1.0-1.25 mm (Gridfinity/web/node/bin_case_fit.mjs, checked for n = 5, 12, 25).
